name: Maximum Activity Projection
definition: A volume rendering technique for 'hot spot' imaging in nuclear medicine that enhances continuity of structures compared to slice display by incorporating depth information and spatial relationships into a 2D image.
summary: Maximum Activity Projection is a volume rendering technique that applies simulated exponential attenuation before selecting the maximum voxel, distinguishing it from Maximum Intensity Projection by weighting voxels by depth to prevent rotation illusions.
